title: Respiratory protective devices: threads for facepieces, Part 1: Standard thread connection
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard prescribes requirements for standard threads for respiratory protective 3.
clause_3_terminology: For the purpose of this standard the
Respiratory protective devices: threads for facepieces

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
